English: We used survival analysis to assess retention at clinic level, Cox regression to examine risk factors for loss to follow up, and competing risk analysis to assess long-term outcomes of people on antiretroviral therapy (ART).
Luganda: Twakozesa okwekaliriza nnakiseera olw’okwekenneenya abalwadde abakyali ku ddagala ku kalwaliro, enkola ya Cox regression okwekenneenya ensonga z’obulabe ez’okufiirwa okulondoola, n’okwekenneenya kw’obulabe obuvuganya okusobola okwekaliriza ebivaamu eby’ekiseera ekiwanvu ku bantu abakozesa eddagala erikkakkanya ku Mukenenya (ART).
Yoruba: A lo ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ìwàláàyè láti lè ní ayè sí ìní ní ipele àyẹ̀wò, àwòṣe oníisrò Cox láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò sí ewu fún ìpàdánù oníkànsí, àti ìṣàtúpalẹ̀ ewu onítakora láti ní àǹfààní sí àbájáde ọjọ́ iwájú àwọn ènìyàn lórí i Ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ Fáírọ́sì-Àǹtìrítíró (ART).
Zulu: Sisebenzise ukuhlaziya ukusinda ukuze sihlole ukugcinwa ezingeni lasemtholampilo, i-Cox regression ukuze sihlole izici eziyingozi zokulahlekelwa okufanele zilandelwe, kanye nokuhlaziya ubungozi obuqhudelanayo ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela yesikhathi eside yabantu abasebenzisa imishanguzo yegciwane lengculazi (ART).
Hausa: Hanyoyi Mun yi amfani da bincike na rayuwa domin tantance tsayawa a matakin asibiti, Ƙididdigar hasashe domin nazarin abubuwan haɗari domin asarar da za a biyo baya, da kuma nazarin haɗarin gasa domin tantance sakamakon dogon lokaci na mutanen da suke kan maganin ƙanjamau (ART).
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše tshekatsheko ya go phologa go sekaseka go tšwela pele ka balwetšo maemo a ka dikliniking, mokgwa wa poelomorago wa Cox o dirišitšwe go lekola mabaka a kotsi a tahlegelo ao re ka a latišišago, le go dira tshekatsheko ya dikotsi go lekola dipoelo tša lebaka le letelele tša batho bao ba lego go kalago ka dianthiretherobaerale (ART).
Amharic: በክሊኒክ ደረጃ ማቆየትን ለመገምገም፣ የኮክስ አማካይ ተዛምዶን ክትትልን ለማጣት የሚያጋልጡ አስጊ ሁኔታዎችን ለመመርመር፣ እና በፀረ-ኤችአይቪ ሕክምና (ኤአርቲ) ላይ ያሉ ሰዎች የረዥም-ጊዜ ውጤቶችን ለመገምገም የደህንነት ትንታኔን ተጠቀምን።

English: We included 132,274 individuals in our analysis, totalling 270,256 person years of follow up (PYFU; median per patient 1.3, interquartile range (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% were female and the median age was 32 years.
Luganda: Abantu kinnoomu be twateeka mu kwekaliriza kwaffe baali 132,274, omugatte abantu 270,256 mu kulondoola (PYFU); omukkati ku buli mulwadde 1.3, IQR 0.26-3.1, abakazi baali 62% ate omukkati gw’emyaka gwali emyaka 32.
Yoruba: A ṣe àfikún ẹni 132,274 sínú ìsàtúpalẹ̀ wa, tí àpapọ̀ jẹ́ iye ọdún ẹni 270,256 oníkèésí (PYFU; àbọ aláìlera kọ̀ọ̀kan 1.3, ìwọn ìdarin (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% jẹ́ obìnrin bẹ́ẹ̀ àbọ ojọ́orí jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 32.
Zulu: Sifake abantu abayi-132,274 ekuhlaziyeni kwethu, okuhlanganisa iminyaka eyi-270,256 yomuntu yokulandelela (i-PYFU; i-median ngesiguli ngasinye 1.3, i-interquartile range (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% kwakungabesifazane kanti iminyaka emaphakathi yayiyiminyaka engu-32.
Hausa: Mun haɗa da mutane guda 132,274 a cikin bincikenmu, jimlar mutane 270,256 a shekaru masu biyo baya (PYFU; matsakaici ga kowane majiyyaci 1.3, kewayon tsaka-tsaki (IQR) 0.26-3.1), 62% mata ne kuma matsakaicin shekaru shi ne shekaru 32.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra akaretša batho ba 132,274 ka tshekatshekong ya rena, e lego palo yeo e fihlago go palomoka ya batho ba 270,256 mo mengwageng yeo ba tlogo latišišwa ka yona (PYFU; boleng bja magareng ka molwetši 1.3, kelo ya magareng ga dikotaranne (IQR) 0.26–3.1), 62% e le basadi le ba mengwaga ya magareng ba na le mengwaga ye 32.
Amharic: በእኛ ትንተና ውስጥ 132,274 ግለሰቦችን አካትተናል፣ በድምሩ 270,256 ሰው የአመት ክትትል (PYFU፣ አማካይ በታካሚ 1.3፣ ኢንተርኳርቲል ክልል (IQR) 0.26-3.1)፣ 62% ሴት እና አማካይ ዕድሜ 32 ዓመት ነበር።

English: Retention on ART was lower in the first year on ART compared to subsequent years for all guideline periods and age groups.
Luganda: Okusigala ku bujjanjabi bwa ART kwali wansi mu mwaka gwa ART ogusooka bw’ogeraageranya n’emyaka egiddirira mu biseera ne mu myaka gyonna.
Yoruba: Dídì ART mú ní ọdún àkọ́kọ́ wá sílẹ̀ lóri ART ka wá fiwé àwọn ọdún tó kù fún gbogbo àwọn àkókò ìtọ́sọ́nà àti àwọn ọjọ́ orí.
Zulu: Ukugcinwa kwama-ART kwakuphansi onyakeni wokuqala kuma-ART uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka eyalandela kuzo zonke izikhathi zemihlahlandlela namaqembu eminyaka yobudala.
Hausa: Tsayawa a kan ART ya kasance ƙasa a cikin shekarar farko a kan ART idan aka kwatanta da shekaru masu zuwa don duk lokutan jagora da rukunonin shekaru.
Northern Sotho: Go tšwetšapele ART go bile fase ka ngwaga wa mathomo go ART ge go bapetšwa le menwgaga ye e latelago go dinako ka moka tša ditlhahli le go dihlopha tša mengwaga.
Amharic: በኤአርቲ ላይ ያለው ማቆየት ለሁሉም የመመሪያ ጊዜዎች እና የዕድሜ ቡድኖች ከቀጣዮቹ ዓመታት ጋር ሲነፃፀር ከመጀመሪያው ዓመት ኤአርቲ ዝቅተኛ ነበር።

English: Infants (0–3 years), adolescents and young adults (15–24 years) were at highest risk of LTFU.
Luganda: Abawere (wakati w’emyaka 0-3), abavubuka n’abo abakuzeemu (emyaka 15 - 24) baalina akatyabaga ka waggulu aka LTFU.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọmọ-ọwọ́ (ọmọ ọdún 0–3), àwọn ọ̀dọ́ àti àwọn àgbàlagbà tọ́ ṣì wà lọ́dọ̀ọ́ (ọmọ ọdún 15–24) wọ́n wà nínú ewu ńlá LTFU.
Zulu: Izinsana (iminyaka engu-0-3), intsha kanye nabantu abadala (iminyaka eli-15-24) babesengozini enkulu ye-LTFU.
Hausa: Jarirai (shekaru 0 zuwa 3), samari da matasa (shekaru 15 zuwa 24) sun kasance cikin haɗari mafi girma na LTFU.
Northern Sotho: Masea (mengwaga ye 0–3), bafsa ba mahlalagading le bafsa (ba mengwaga ye 15–24) ba be ba le kotsing ye kglo ya LTFU.
Amharic: ጨቅላ ህፃናት (0-3 አመት)፣ ጎረምሶች እና ወጣት ጎልማሶች (15-24 አመት) ለLTFU ከፍተኛ ተጋላጭነት አላቸው።

English: Comparing the different calendar periods of ART initiation we found that retention improved initially, but remained stable thereafter.
Luganda: Mu kugeraageranya ebiseera by’okutandika ART eby’enjawulo, twazuula ng’okusigala ku bujjanjabi kwalongooka mu kusooka, naye ne kutebenkera mu biseera ebyaddirira.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣàfiwé oríṣiríṣi àwọn àkókó ìdásílẹ̀ kàlẹ́ńdà ART, a ri pé dídìmú gbẹ̀rú si ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ó padà dúro sójú kan lẹ́yìn ìgbà náà.
Zulu: Uma siqhathanisa izikhathi zekhalenda ezihlukene zokuqaliswa kwe-ART sithole ukuthi ukugcinwa kwaba ngcono ekuqaleni, kodwa kwahlala kuzinzile ngemva kwalokho.
Hausa: Ta hanyar kwatanta lokuta daban-daban na kalanda na ƙaddamarwar ART mun gano cewa tsayawar ta inganta da farko, amma ta kasance mai ƙarfi daga baya.
Northern Sotho: Ge g bapetšwa dinako tše di bapanego tša ka khalentareng tša thomišo ya ART re hwweditše gore go tšwetša pele go ile gwa kaonafala mathomong, eupša gwa tšwela pele go ba seemong se tee ka morago ga fao.
Amharic: የተለያዩ የኤአርቲ አጀማመር የቀን መቁጠሪያ ጊዜዎችን በማነፃፀር ማቆየት መጀመሪያ ላይ እንደተሻሻለ፣ ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ የተረጋጋ ሆኖ አግኝተነዋል።

English: Conclusion
Luganda: Okukubira
Yoruba: Ìkádìí
Zulu: Isiphetho
Hausa: Kammalawa

English: Even though the number of patients and the burden on health care system increased substantially during the study period of rapid ART expansion, retention on ART improved in the early years of ART provision, but gains in retention were not maintained over 5 years on ART.
Luganda: Okukubira wadde ng’omuwendo gw’abalwadde n’okunyigiriza ebyobujjanjabi byeyongerera ddala nnyo mu kiseera ky’okunoonyereza kuno okw’okugaziya ART, okubeera ku ddagala lya ART kweyongera mu myaka gy’okufuna ART egyasooka, naye ebibala by’okubeera ku ddagala tebyeyongera mu maaso kusukka myaka 5 egya ART.
Yoruba: Ní ìparí kódà látàrí iye àwọn aláìsàn àti búkàtá ètò ìtọ́jú ìléra ní ìlọsíwájú tó dára lásìkò ìwádìí ART tó gbóòrò, ìdìmú ART gbẹ́rù si ní àwọn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ ọdún tí wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ ART, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò ṣe àmójútó àwọn èrè nínú dídìmú ART ní bí nǹkan bíi ọdún 5.
Zulu: Nakuba inani leziguli kanye nomthwalo ohlelweni lokunakekelwa kwezempilo wenyuka kakhulu ngesikhathi socwaningo lokunwetshwa okusheshayo kwe-ART, ukugcinwa kwe-ART kwaba ngcono eminyakeni yokuqala yokuhlinzekwa kwe-ART, kodwa ukuzuza ekugcineni akuzange kunakekelwe eminyakeni eyi-5 kuma-ART.
Hausa: Kammalawa Ko da yake yawan marasa lafiya da nauyin tsarin kiwon lafiya ya ƙaru sosai a lokacin nazarin binciken gaggawa na faɗaɗa ART, tsayawa a kan ART ya inganta a farkon shekarun samar da ART, amma ba a ci gaba da samun ci gaba a cikin shekaru 5 a kan ART ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore palo ya balwetši le morwalo go lenaneo la tlhokomelo ya maphelo o ile wa oketšega kudu ka nakong ya dinyakišišo ya katološo ye kgolo ya ART, go tšwela pele ka ART go kaonafetše mengwageng ya mathomong ya kabo ya ART, eupša mehola ya go e tšwetša pele ga se ya tšwetšwa pele mo mengwageng ye 5 ya ge ba alfša ka ART.

English: They studied information that was gathered from 132,274 patients who all received ARTs for the first time during the first decade that the treatment was made available freely to all Malawians.
Luganda: Beekaliriza obubaka obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu balwadde 132,274 bonna nga baafuna ART omulundi gwabwe ogusookedde ddala mu myaka ekkumi egisooka obujjanjabi obwo we bwatuusibwa ku bantu ku bwereere eri Bannamalawi bonna.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo ìròyìn tí a gbàjọ láti ọ̀dọ àwọn aláìsàn 132,274 tọ́ gba ARTs fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ ní dẹ́kéèdì àkọ́kọ́ pé ìtọ́jú náà jẹ́ èyí tó wà lárọ̀ọ́wọ́tọ́ àwọn ọmọ orílẹ̀-ède Malawi.
Zulu: Bacwaninge ulwazi olwaqoqwa ezigulini eziyi-132,274 zonke ezathola ama-ART okokuqala ngqa phakathi neminyaka eyishumi yokuqala lapho ukwelashwa kwenziwa ukuthi kutholakale mahhala kubo bonke abantu base-Malawi.
Hausa: Sun yi nazarin bayanan da aka tattara daga majiyyata guda 132,274 waɗanda duk suka sami ARTs a karon farko a cikin shekaru goma na farko cewa an ba da magani kyauta ga duk ’yan Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lekola tshedimošo yeo e kgobokeditšwego go balwetši ba 132,274 bao ka moka ga bona ba hweditšego di-ART la mathomo ka nakong ya ngwagasome wa mathomo fao kalafo e filwego badudi ba Malawi ka moka.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያዎቹ አስርት አመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ARTs ከተቀበሉ ከ132,274 ታካሚዎች የተሰበሰበ መረጃን በማጥናት ህክምናው ለሁሉም የማላዊ ዜጎች በነጻ እንዲደርስ ተደርጓል።

English: The patients attended 21 hospitals and health centres in Malawi.
Luganda: Abalwadde baali mu malwaliro 21 n’ebifo by’obujjanjabi mu Malawi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn náà lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn 21 àti gbọ̀gàn ìlera ní Malawi.
Zulu: Iziguli zaya ezibhedlela nasezikhungweni zezempilo ezinga-21 e-Malawi.
Hausa: Majiyyatan sun halarci asibitoci guda 21 da cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya a Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba ile ba ya dipetleleng tše 21 le mafelong a tša maphelo ka Malawi.
Amharic: ታማሚዎቹ በማላዊ 21 ሆስፒታሎች እና ጤና ጣቢያዎች ገብተዋል።

English: The results show that since 2004, Malawians using ARTs have become better at regularly taking their treatment.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu biraga nti okuva mu 2004, Bannamalawi abakozesa ARTs beeyongedde okujjumbuira obulungi mu kufuna obujjanjabi bwabwe.
Yoruba: Èsì náà fi hàn pé láti 2004, àwọn ọmọ orílẹ̀-ède Malawi nípa lilo ARTs ti dára si nípa gbígba ìtọ́jú wọn lóòrèkóòrè.
Zulu: Imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi kusukela ngowezi-2004, abantu base-Malawi abasebenzisa ama-ART sebengcono ekuphuzeni njalo imishanguzo yabo.
Hausa: Sakamakon ya nuna cewa tun daga shekarar 2004, ’yan Malawi da suke amfani da ARTs suna ƙara ingata wajen shan maganinsu akai-akai.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di laetša gore go tloga ka 2004, badudi ba Malawi bao ba bego ba šomiša di-ART ba thomile go ba kaone ka go nwa dihlare tša bona kgafetšakgafetša.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት ከ 2004 ጀምሮ፣ ARTs የሚጠቀሙ ማላዊያውያን በመደበኛነት ህክምናቸውን በመውሰድ የተሻሉ ሆነዋል።

English: The first year was generally the most difficult for patients to get through.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, omwama ogusooka gwe gwali omukalubo ennyo eri abalwadde.
Yoruba: Ọdún àkọ́kọ́ ló le jù fún àwọn aláìsàn láti borí.
Zulu: Unyaka wokuqala wawuvame ukuba nzima kakhulu ezigulini ukuba zidlule kuwo.
Hausa: Shekara ta farko gabaɗaya ita ce mafi wahala ga majayyata farin shiga.
Northern Sotho: Ngwaga wa mathomo ka kakaretšo e bile o boima kudu ka kakaretšo gore balwetši ba tlwaele kalafo.
Amharic: የመጀመሪያው ዓመት በአጠቃላይ ለታካሚዎች በጣም አስቸጋሪው ነበር።

English: Thereafter the chances were high that they would regularly return to clinics to receive new doses of ARTs, for the rest of their lives.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekyo, emikisa gyabwe gyeyongera okuddanga ku bulwaliro okufuna doozi za ART endala ebbanga lyabwe lyonna ery’obulamu.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náà ó dára bí wọ́n ṣe ń lọ sí gbọ̀gàn ìtọ́jú láti gba ARTs tuntun, léyìí tó kì ọjọ́ ayé wọn.
Zulu: Ngemuva kwalokho aba maningi amathuba okuthi bazobuyela njalo emitholampilo ukuze bathole imithamo emisha yemishanguzo yama-ART, impilo yabo yonke.
Hausa: Bayan haka, damar tana da yawa cewa za su iya koma wa asibitoci akai-akai don karɓar sababin magunguna na ARTs, har tsawon rayuwarsu.
Northern Sotho: Ka morago ga fao dibaka di bile godimo tša gore ba tla boela dikliniking kgafetšakgafetša go hwetša dilekanyo tše diswa tša di-ART, maphelong a bona ka moka.
Amharic: ከዚያም በቀሪው ሕይወታቸው፣ አዲስ የ ARTs መጠኖችን ለመቀበል ወደ ክሊኒኮች የመመለስ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ነበር።

English: After first starting the treatment, 3 in every 5 people (62%) kept on doing so.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’okutandika ku bujjanjabi obusooka, abantu 3 ku 5 (62%) baddanga okubufuna.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìb bíbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú náà, ẹni 3 nínú 5 (62%) máa ń ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.
Zulu: Ngemva kokuqala imishwanguzo, aba-3 kubantu aba-5 (62%) baqhubeka nokwenza kanjalo.
Hausa: Bayan fara magani, mutum 3 cikin kowane mutane 5 (62%) suna ci gaba da yin hakan.
Northern Sotho: Ka morago ga go thomiša ka kalafo la mathomo, batho ba 3 go ba bangwe le ba bangwe ba 5 (62%) ba ile ba tšwela pele go dira seo.
Amharic: ህክምናውን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከጀመሩ በኋላ፣ ከ5 ሰዎች ውስጥ 3ቱ (62%) ያደርጉት ነበር።

English: Some (4,6%) of the others died, while the rest never returned to a clinic to get more medicine.
Luganda: Abamu (4,6%) ku bo baafa, ate abalala tebaddira ddala ku kalwaliro kufuna ddagala ddala.
Yoruba: Àwọn mìíràn (4,6%) tó kù kú, nígbà tí àwọn tó kù ò padà sí gbọ̀gàn ìlera mọ́ fún ọ̀pọ oògùn.
Zulu: Abanye (4,6%) babanye bashona, kanti abanye abaphindanga babuyela emtholampilo ukuyothola eminye imithi.
Hausa: Wasu (4,6%) na sauran sun mutu, a yayin da sauran ba sa ƙara koma wa asibiti don samun ƙarin magani.
Northern Sotho: Ba bangwe (4,6%) ba bona ba hlokofetše, mola ba bangwe ba se ba ka ba boela kliniking go hwetša dihlare tše dingwe.
Amharic: ከሌሎቹ (4.6%) የሚሆኑት ሞተዋል፣ የተቀሩት ግን ተጨማሪ መድኃኒት ለማግኘት ወደ ክሊኒክ አልተመለሱም።

English: More women started using ARTs during the course of the decade.
Luganda: Abakyala bangiko baatandika okukozesa ART mu kiseera ky’emyaka ekkumi.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ obìnrin ló bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí lo ARTs ní dẹ́kéèdì náà.
Zulu: Abesifazane abaningi baqale ukusebenzisa ama-ART phakathi neminyaka eyishumi.
Hausa: Ƙarin mata da yawa sun fara amfani da ARTs a cikin shekaru goma.
Northern Sotho: Basadi ba bantši ba ile ba thoma go šomiša di-ART ka nakong yeo ya mengwaga ye lesome.
Amharic: በአስር አመታት ውስጥ ብዙ ሴቶች ARTsን መጠቀም ጀመሩ።

English: Men, infants and younger adults between 15 and 24 years old stopped taking their treatment more often than other groups of patients.
Luganda: Abasajja, abato n’embulakalevu abali wakati w’emyaka 15 ne 24 egy’obukulu baalekera awo okukozesa eddagala lyabwe okusinga ebibinja by’abalwadde abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọkùnrin, àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ láàárín ọmọ ọdún 15 àti 24 kò gba ìtọ́jú wọn bí àwọn ọ̀wọ́ aláìlera tó kù.
Zulu: Amadoda, izinsana kanye nabantu abadala abasebasha abaphakathi kweminyaka eli-15 nama-24 ubudala bayeke ukuphuza imithi yabo njalo kaningi kunamanye amaqembu eziguli.
Hausa: Maza da jarirai da matasa masu shekaru tsakanin 15 zuwa 24 sun daina shan maganinsu fiye da sauran rukunin marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banna, masea le bfsa ba mengwaga ye 15 le ye 24 ba ile ba emiša go nwa dihlare tša bona gantši kudu go feta dihlopha tše dingwe tša balwetši.
Amharic: ከ15 እስከ 24 ዓመት የሆናቸው ወንዶች፣ ጨቅላ ሕፃናት እና ወጣት ጎልማሶች ከሌሎች የሕመምተኞች ቡድኖች በበለጠ ብዙ ጊዜ ህክምናቸውን አቁመዋል።

English: These results were similar to the findings of studies previously done in Malawi, Ethiopia and other African countries.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa bino bifaananako n’ebyo ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa mu Malawi, Ethiopia ne mu mawanga ga Afirika amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì yí jọ àwọn ti àtẹ̀yìnwá tí wọ́n ṣe ní Malawi, Ethopia, àti àwọn ìlú ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà mìíràn.
Zulu: Le miphumela ibifana nemiphumela yocwaningo olwenziwe ngaphambilini e-Malawi, Ethiopia nakwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon sun yi kama da sakamakon binciken da aka yi a baya a ƙasar Malawi da Habasha da sauran ƙasashen Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di be di swana le dikutollo tša dinyakišišo tšeo di dirilwego mo nakong ye e fetilego ka Malawi, Ethiopia le ka dinageng tše dingwe tša Afrika.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች ከዚህ ቀደም በማላዊ፣ ኢትዮጵያ እና በሌሎች የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ከተደረጉ ጥናቶች ግኝቶች ጋር ተመሳሳይ ናቸው።

English: It showed again that it remains difficult for patients to keep taking their treatment.
Luganda: Era kwalaga nti kikyali kizibu eri abalwadde okweyongera okufuna obujjanjabi bwabwe.
Yoruba: Ó fi hàn lẹ́ẹ̀kan si pé ó lè fún àwọn aláìlera láti máa tẹ̀síwájú ní gbígba ìtọ́jú wọn.
Zulu: Kuphinde kwakhombisa ukuthi kusenzima ezigulini ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuthatha imishanguzo yazo.
Hausa: Ya sake nuna cewa yana da wahala ga majiyyata su ci gaba da shan maganinsu.
Northern Sotho: Go laeditše gape gore go tšwela pele go ba boima go balwetši go tšwela pele go nwa dihlare tša bona.
Amharic: ለታካሚዎች ህክምናቸውን መቀጠል አስቸጋሪ እንደሆነ በድጋሚ አሳይቷል።

English: However, the researchers caution that they did not have the correct and complete information of all Malawian patients who had received ARTs since 2004 for this study.
Luganda: Wabula, abanoonyereza balabula nti tebaalina bubaka butuufu era nga bujjuvu ku balwadde Bannamalawi bonna abaali bafuna ART okuva mu 2004 mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Yoruba: Ẁayí o, àwọn olùsèwádìí kìlọ̀ pé àwọn ò ní ìròyìn tó yege tàbi tó pé fún gbogbo àwọn aláìlera Malawi tó ti gba ARTs láti ọdun 2004 fún iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí.
Zulu: Nokho, abacwaningi baxwayisa ngokuthi babengenalo ulwazi olunembile noluphelele lwazo zonke iziguli zase-Malawi ezathola ama-ART kusukela ngowezi-2004 kulolu cwaningo.
Hausa: Duk da haka, masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa ba su da cikakken bayani game da duk majiyyata na ƙasar Malawi da suka karɓi ARTs tun daga shekarar 2004 don wannan binciken.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, banyakišiši ba lemoša gore ga se ba ba le tshedimošo ye e nepagetšego le yeo e feletšego ka ga balwetši ka moka ba Malawia bao ba ilego ba hwetša di-ART go thoma ka 2004 mo dinyakišišong tše.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ለዚህ ጥናት ከ2004 ጀምሮ ARTs የተቀበሉ የማላዊ ታካሚዎች ትክክለኛ እና የተሟላ መረጃ እንደሌላቸው ያስጠነቅቃሉ።

English: The researchers conclude that support is especially needed to keep Malawian teenagers, young adults and men on ARTs.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bakubira nti okuyamba naddala okukuuma Bannamalawi abatiini, abavubuka n’abasajja abakozesa ART kwetaagisa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà fẹnu kò pé ìrànwọ́ jẹ́ kókó lá ri pé àwọn ògowẹẹrẹ, ọ̀dọ́ àti àwọn ọkùnrin Malawi wà lórí ARTs.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi ukusekelwa kuyadingeka ikakhulukazi ukugcina intsha yase-Malawi, abantu abasha kanye namadoda kuma-ART.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kammala da cewa ana buƙatar tallafi musamman domin kiyaye matasa da kuma maza ’yan Malawi a kan ARTs.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba feditše ka gore thekgo e tloga e hlokagala go dira gore bafsa ba mahlalagading ba ka Malawi, bafsa le banna ba new di-ART.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተለይም የማላዊ ታዳጊዎችን፣ ወጣቶችን እና ወንዶችን በARTs ላይ ለማቆየት ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልግ ድምዳሜ ላይ ደርሰዋል።

English: Health workers can help by sending text messages to their patients to remind them about their treatment, by starting support clubs or by providing counselling.
Luganda: Abasawo basobola okuyamba nga basindika obubaka bw’oku ssimu eri abalwadde baabwe okubajjukiza eddagala lyabwe, nga batandikawo ebibiina ebiyamba oba okubasomesa.
Yoruba: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlerá lè ṣe ìrànwọ́ nípa fífi àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ ráńṣẹ́ sí àwọn aláìlera wọn láti rán wọn létí nípa ìtọ́jú wọn, nípa dídá ẹgbẹ́ ìrànwọ́ sílẹ̀ tàbí ṣiṣe ẹ̀kọ́ ìgbaniníyànjú.
Zulu: Abasebenzi bezempilo bangasiza ngokuthumela imiyalezo ezigulini zabo ukuze bazikhumbuze ngemishwanguzo yazo, ngokuqala amakilabhu okusekelana noma ngokunikeza ukwelulekwa.
Hausa: Ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya za su iya taimakawa ta hanyar aika saƙonnin rubutu zuwa ga majiyyatansu domin tunatar da su game da maganinsu, ta hanyar fara ƙungiyoyi na tallafi ko ta hanyar bayar da shawara.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša maphelo ba ka thuša ka go romela balwetši ba bona melaetša ya go ngwalwa go ba gopotša ka ga dihlare tša bona, ka go thomiša ka ditlelapo tša thekgo goba ka go fana ka keletšo.
Amharic: የጤና ሰራተኞች ስለ ህክምናቸው ለማስታወስ ወደ ታካሚዎቻቸው የጽሑፍ መልእክቶችን በመላክ፣ የድጋፍ ክበቦችን በመጀመር ወይም የምክር አገልግሎት በመስጠት መርዳት ይችላሉ።
